failure_summary.description: Responses differed from the expected granularity or surface form, including an expanded or alternate name, a specific year instead of a century, and singular instead of plural.
Agents returned an example, a related clue detail, or a truth value instead of the requested role or person, despite existing answer-slot guidance.

patch.reasoning: The skill already covers concise answer forms, temporal granularity, and identifying the requested answer slot, so repeating those rules would not address the main compliance failures. Grammatical-number matching is not explicit; adding it may help prevent singular answers where the clue and answer refer to multiple items.

edits.target: - Use the context-supported conventional form of a name or answer, and include additional name parts only when needed to distinguish otherwise-confusable entities.
edits.content: - Preserve grammatical number: use a plural answer when the clue asks for multiple members or refers to a plural set, rather than normalizing the answer to a singular form.
